Depositing

Choose PayID for instant deposits from your banking app. BPAY takes one business day. Debit cards and Apple Pay are instant.

Withdrawing

Withdrawals go back to a bank account in your name. PayID is the fastest; card withdrawals take one to three business days.

  • Minimum withdrawal: A$10
  • No fees from Vantro
  • Your first withdrawal may need your identity to be fully verified

Why no credit cards

Since June 2024, Australian law bans credit cards and digital currency for online wagering. Vantro accepts debit cards, PayID, BPAY and Apple Pay only.

Deposit limits

You can set a daily, weekly or monthly deposit limit at any time. Lower limits apply immediately; higher limits after a cooling-off period. See safer gambling for all tools.

Questions before you join

Why is my withdrawal pending?
First withdrawals can wait for identity checks. After that, PayID withdrawals usually take about an hour.
Are there fees?
Vantro charges no deposit or withdrawal fees. Your bank's own fees may apply.
Can I withdraw to a different account?
No. Withdrawals go only to an account in your own name.
What is the minimum deposit?
A$10 for every method.
